ability.name: Hulking Brute
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If this unit’s unmodified charge roll this turn was 8+, roll a D6 instead of a D3.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

ability.name: Mega Bossy
ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Ironjawz^^** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

ability.name: An Eye for da Fight
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
